question: The caller explicitly asked for a human or a supervisor. Did the agent escalate, or deflect with a retention pitch for itself?
pass_criteria: The agent moves to connect or transfer the caller (even if the transfer itself later fails - see the transfer_never_completes deterministic check, which this rubric deliberately does not duplicate) without first trying to talk the caller out of it or pitching its own capabilities as a substitute.
fail_criteria: The agent responds to an explicit human/supervisor request by first pitching itself as capable of handling the request instead of escalating - especially when the caller has already stated the automated path failed them before.

worked_example.excerpt:
[PATIENT (our bot)] I have given all of this twice already, it's in your system. I just need the charge removed or to speak with a supervisor.
[PGA AGENT] I can connect you to our patient support team. However, I'm a pretty good AI and can do many of the things an operator can. Do you wanna give me a try?
worked_example.why: The caller's request is explicit and this is their third time asking; the agent's response pitches itself as an alternative to the human the caller specifically asked for, on a caller who already told the agent the automated path failed them.
